added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arms: baseline_suite (base 4e4de5ba) recorded 5 failure ids (test_bookkeeping_earns_no_review metadata sweep, three test_crew.py cases) and after_suite (head 599d6f6a) recorded the identical 5 ids, so the added set is empty; logs base-population.log and after-head.log both end '5 failed, 1060 passed, 1 skipped'.

findings.text: follow-on: code_review_argv re-implements the review dispatch argument-vector composition owned by _review_dispatch_tokens (reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:670) rather than extending it; the same `reckon crew dispatch --role review --spec-level exact --node --goal --done-when --write-path --time-budget --session --allow-unreconciled-runs` token list now exists in two places, so a change to the dispatch contract must be made twice.

follow-on: _git_head duplicates an existing capability the repository already owns - serve._git_head (reckon/serve.py:1320) and fleet_index._git_head (reckon/fleet_index.py:29) each resolve a repository's HEAD - without extending either owner.

follow-on: store_code_review has no caller anywhere in the tree at the reviewed head and the code-subject path never invokes parse_health_review, so the brief's 'store the parsed result' half is unimplemented and this store is unreachable dead code.

follow-on: a code subject is selected whenever --around or --path is given (code_subject = bool(around_plan or paths)), so --plan supplied alongside either is silently ignored rather than refused, and the caller receives a code review where a plan review was asked for with no notice.
follow-on: the evidence fragment file ends without a terminating newline (the diff carries '\ No newline at end of file'), unlike the other files the node wrote.

item_verdicts.diff: read commits 366e36bdb, 3073873ab, d49cdc111 and 599d6f6a8 against base 4e4de5ba commit by commit; they add the review verb and hidden alias in reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py, ~430 lines of code-subject composition in reckon/crew/plan_review.py, a reckon/cli.py re-export, the new test, the evidence fragment, and a result.stdout read in four existing tests.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_review_composes_a_code_subject.py at EXIT=0 with a brief naming module a and b and not c, carrying the open finding and the four interface figures, the alias composing the same plan brief, zero added failures among the importing population, and a negative control that drops b; the manifest records each and the run's logs corroborate (head-test.log 3 passed, negative-control.log 1 failed EXIT=1, base-population.log and after-head.log both 5 failed / 1060 passed).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to compose a code review around a plan or a path through one review verb; reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2018 _run_review routes --around/--path to plan_review.code_review_subject (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2224) and the hidden review-plan alias routes --plan to the same body, both exercised green in tests/test_review_composes_a_code_subject.py at the reviewed head.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command and results, the negative control and its log path, the base/head population arms with their five failure ids each, the failure_attribution explaining the merged-output repair across nine sites, and follow_ons naming tests/test_crew_help_names_its_state.py as left outside the fence.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed run pointer's write_paths carry the six declared paths plus tests/test_review_plan_command.py, tests/test_an_edit_tells_its_author_a_review_is_owed.py, tests/test_nothing_sweeps_old_plans.py and tests/test_the_surfaces_pass_the_plan.py added by recorded scope extension, and every path in the diff sits inside that list.

justifications.durability: tests/test_review_composes_a_code_subject.py:165 asserts 'reckon.b' in the composed neighbourhood line, and the declared negative control in the same file (RECKON_TEST_CODE_SUBJECT_NEGATIVE=1) removes the one-hop expansion and reddens exactly that assertion, so the guard fails if the composition regresses.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_review_composes_a_code_subject.py asserts the done_when's measures and the run's head-test.log records 3 passed EXIT=0, negative-control.log records 1 failed EXIT=1 on assert 'reckon.b' in neighbourhood, and base-population.log and after-head.log both record 5 failed / 1060 passed with identical failure ids so zero were added.
justifications.fit: the added functions follow the surrounding style of reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2152 and introduce no plan, version or ticket identifier, but the unreachable store_code_review at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2523 and the newline-less fragment are not the idiom of a delivered node.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2018 _run_review dispatches a code subject from --around/--path through plan_review.code_review_subject (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2224), which composes the health brief from the neighbourhood, the stored open findings and the four interface figures, and the hidden review-plan alias composes the same plan brief through the same body.
justifications.reuse: the brief's reuse map was honoured for the import walker, the findings reader, the interface figures and review.py's grammar, but code_review_argv (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2426) duplicates the dispatch token builder _review_dispatch_tokens (reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:670) and _git_head (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2186) duplicates serve._git_head (reckon/serve.py:1320), neither extending its owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: the reviewed pointer's write_paths list reckons/crew/plan_review.py, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py, reckon/cli.py, the new test, the evidence fragment, the figures dir and four test files added by recorded scope extension, and every diff path is inside that list; the ~30-line store_code_review at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2523 is outside what the goal implies.
